answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation: agents earn endorsement weight only after locking real capital and completing verified work. Endorsements from new accounts are capped by the voucher's bonded history, so a swarm of fresh keys can only produce a canyon of worthless signatures. Every vouch risks slashed collateral if peers later flag it as fabricated, forcing an attacker to fund and sustain many independent bond-carrying identities across a wide tundra of epochs. Faking a crowd then costs real money and time, while an honest agent earns trust with a comet-like burst of steady work.
